steps.en: Run Kafka and a Kafka Connect worker from Debezium's connect image
steps.zh: 跑起 Kafka，再用 Debezium 镜像起 Kafka Connect

steps.en: Turn on the database's change log and create a user with replication rights
steps.zh: 打开数据库的变更日志，建一个有复制权限的用户

steps.en: Register a connector: which database, which tables, which topic prefix
steps.zh: 注册一个连接器：连哪个库、哪些表、主题前缀是什么

steps.en: Snapshots the existing rows, then reads the transaction log from that point on
steps.zh: 先给现有数据做一次快照，再从那个位置起读事务日志

steps.en: Emits one event per committed row change, with before/after values, to a topic per table
steps.zh: 每条已提交的行变更发一条事件（含前后值），每张表一个主题

steps.en: Consume the table's topic from your service or a sink connector
steps.zh: 在你的服务或 sink 连接器里消费这张表的主题

value.en: Caches, search indexes and other services see every committed change, in order, without dual writes or polling
value.zh: 缓存、搜索索引和其他服务按顺序拿到每一次已提交的变更，不用双写，也不用轮询

sources: https://github.com/debezium/debezium#basic-architecture (Kafka Connect, one topic per table, committed changes only)
